description: frost_giant_child default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (pale facets lifted to the sheet's white-blue ice, blue facets to the sheet's blue, eye sockets painted pale) baked onto the low (improved/textures/frost_giant_child_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it; one GLOW region (eye_glow) carries the soft eye emission

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode; white = as baked). Sheet chips for reference: 233,233,232 / 177,210,243 / 105,163,236 / 84,104,150 / accent 128,144,249

eye_glow.note: the pale eye interiors: rgb white keeps the baked (pale) albedo; emission = the sheet's eye-interior colour (front view, median 194,233,243) x 0.7 (soft self-lit glow, spec 'glowing pale eyes'; at x 0.4 the recessed, AO-darkened sockets rendered 157,188,199 against a 255 face, darker than the face where the sheet draws them as bright as it)
